summary.plain: The engineering plan for reusing Brookhaven's muon storage ring at Fermilab to remeasure the muon's magnetic anomaly four times more precisely.
summary.technical: FERMILAB-FN-0992-E / arXiv:1501.06858: Technical Design Report for Fermilab E989, describing the physics motivation, the reuse of the E821 storage ring relocated from BNL, and the design of the new detector and beamline needed to reach 0.14 ppm precision.
